method.primary: Frozen EMG1 shoulder-negative/elbow-positive relationships and prior ridge decoder evaluated on new pick-1 recording
method.alignment: fixed +50 ms label offset; no lag search
method.labels: same torso-referenced 3D shoulder elevation, elbow bend and unsigned wrist proxy on both blocks; not prompted target
method.bootstrap: Percentile 95% intervals, paired time-block resampling within acquisition segment and round; 5 s primary, 2/10 s sensitivity; partial blocks retained. Blocks never cross EMG acquisition gaps; missing camera rows within blocks are excluded without compressing time.
method.clock_mapping: Source retains original first60%-OLS mapping. New recording uses nominal unit device-clock slope and first60%-median receipt offset, selected from timestamp-only startup-backlog evidence before any transfer evaluation; original OLS is sensitivity only.
method.inference_limits: Descriptive conditional intervals in short nonstationary recordings, not population confidence. Singleton strata do not contribute resampling variance; requested long blocks may be much shorter after gaps.
method.multiplicity: Two previously selected EMG1 pair/sign checks; other correlations and uncorrected pointwise intervals exploratory. No p values reported.
